topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, would you look at that! Seems our little one's got the same master of the books as I did. I remember him well, a stout man with a heart as wide as the fields we sow. He taught me not just letters but the value of every word, every tale. It's a fine comfort to think my child will hear the same wisdom, maybe even catch a glimpse of the world beyond our village walls through his tales. I'll take young Elsie to meet him, introduce her to the books that once held me spellbound. Perhaps we'll hear some old stories, ones that carry the warmth of the hearth and the hope of a bountiful year.
